text:
Jordan M: Heads-up — scheduling the EU->APAC stepped traffic carve this Thursday 09:00 UTC. Quick async sync: who is executing, smoke window ownership, TTL change plan (if any), and explicit rollback command we can run from runbox?

Maria Chen: I can own the smoke checks for EU and APAC. I'll run the checklist after each step and paste results. Services to validate: api-front, inference-gateway, auth-proxy.

Lee K: I'll run the weight changes. Proposed rollout is stepped: 15% -> 50% -> 100% for APAC with ~10m gaps. Prefer weighted LB adjustments rather than full DNS TTL churn.

Samira (oncall): Weighted LB sounds safer. If we need DNS TTL change, let's do it >2h before to avoid cache inconsistencies. Otherwise I'm fine with weights. I'll be monitoring SLOs.

deploy-bot: Deploy job queued: rollout/edge-policy-2026-03. Estimated end-to-end time 35m. Smoke window reserved 09:05-09:40 UTC.

Jordan M: Ok — final proposal: do NOT touch global DNS unless absolutely required. Plan weights as: EU -> APAC (start APAC 15%): EU 85/15, then 70/30, then 50/50, then APAC 100. NA unchanged. Lee, can you publish the weight changes and confirm the exact commands?

Lee K: Yep. Script I will run (from runbox):
```bash
# step 1 to 30% APAC
apictl weights set --route edge-global --weights "eu=70,apac=30,na=0"
# convenient rollback
apictl weights set --route edge-global --weights "eu=100,apac=0,na=0"
```
Immediate rollback command (quick): `apictl roll traffic --route edge-global --set-weight eu=100,apac=0`

Maria Chen: Smoke checklist (short):
- health endpoints: `curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} %{time_total}\n" https://api.redwood.example/status` should return 200 and <200ms
- basic inference: run 3 sample prompts against inference-gateway, check for consistency and no model fallbacks/errors
- qps/latency dashboards: token latency <250ms p95, error rate <0.5%
- dig check for IPs after weight change: `dig +short @8.8.8.8 api.redwood.example`
I'll post results after 09:05, 09:15, 09:25.

Samira (oncall): Paging/incident rules: I'll open #incidents if we hit error rate >1% sustained for 5m or >=500 errors in 10m. Ops-sre gets paged automatically for infra regressions.

Jordan M: Good. Also add a quick smoke probe for function/tool-calls and streaming endpoints. Maria, can you run a 30s stream test in each step?

Maria Chen: Yep — will include a 30s stream probe. I'll paste sample outputs inline.

Lee K: One more note — we'll reduce route propagation risk by waiting ~2m after each weight change before marking the step as passed. If anything looks off I revert to the rollback command above.

ops-sre: FYI — I'll keep an eye on LB health. If control plane fails, we'll flip the external load balancer back to EU via oncall runbook.

Jordan M: Timeline recap:
- 07:00 UTC: (optional) lower DNS TTL to 60 if the team still prefers DNS change — decision: prefer NO
- 09:00 UTC: Step 0 start, set APAC 15% (baseline)
- 09:05 UTC: Maria runs smoke step-0
- 09:10 UTC: Step 1 to 30%
- 09:15 UTC: Maria smoke step-1
- 09:20 UTC: Step 2 to 50%
- 09:25 UTC: Maria smoke step-2
- 09:30 UTC: Final cutover to APAC 100% if all good

Jordan M: Who will post the short status updates in #eng-platform during the ops window?

Maria Chen: I'll post the smoke summaries after each check and include the dig/curl outputs.

Lee K: I'll post the exact apictl commands I run and timestamps.

Samira (oncall): I'll post if I open #incidents and will paste alert thresholds.

Jordan M: Perfect. Everyone: add your :thumbsup: here if you're good with the plan and who does what.

Lee K: 👍

Maria Chen: ack 

Samira (oncall): oncall and ready :white_check_mark:

Jordan M: Great — see you all in the window. If anything unexpected, immediate rollback as per command above and page ops-sre. :thumbsup:
